meijer1993-hepatocyte-swelling.preparation: Isolated hepatocytes from fasted rats at 37 °C.
meijer1993-hepatocyte-swelling.pool_readout: Figure 3E reports cellular ATP amount. Figure 3F uses cell water from the 45 min measurement in Figure 1 to calculate ATP concentration. In the no-added-amino-acid series the amount rose slightly with swelling and calculated concentration fell by at most about 10%.

proteolysis.locator: Table 2, accumulated valine production without added amino acids
proteolysis.unit: micromol valine per g dry cells

amino_acid_interaction.locator: Figure 2B and Results, physiological amino-acid mixture at 90 min
amino_acid_interaction.denominator: Each value uses the no-added-amino-acid control at its own osmolarity.

haussinger1991-perfused-liver-swelling.preparation: Perfused livers from fed rats at 37 °C. Isotonic control 305 mOsm/L, hypo-osmotic perfusion 185–275 mOsm/L.
haussinger1991-perfused-liver-swelling.water_readout: Difference between urea and inulin distribution spaces, measured about 30 min apart.
haussinger1991-perfused-liver-swelling.proteolysis_readout: Leucine label released from previously labelled liver proteins, relative to each liver's baseline. The perfusate contained 0.1 mM unlabelled leucine.
haussinger1991-perfused-liver-swelling.observation: The hypo-osmotic protocols increased intracellular water space and decreased labelled leucine release.
haussinger1991-perfused-liver-swelling.uncertainty: Water and label release came from separate groups under matched protocols. Figure 1 reports means and SEM with 3–15 experiments per point across conditions. Some values were reused from earlier work by the group.
